reviews.review:
The worst parts of this game were my first impression and my last impression, everything else in between was just okay.

The game keeps you from progressing via physical barriers which are removed once you've read all the notes in the area, but due to a bug at the beginning, those notes didn't spawn in, so I was forced to restart and take that long walk a total of 3 times before I got lucky and the game worked.

Since this is a walking sim, of course there's no real threat to the player, but it makes no sense narratively why we keep going deeper into the monster's den. The protagonist has the most underwhelming reaction to the cosmic horrors he's witnessing, just a complete lack of survival instincts, at one point opting to go directly into the danger he was expressly warned not to venture into.

As for the "one insane twist that you don't want to miss out on" that the dev so proudly promised on the store page...? Well, your mileage my vary. For me, personally, it was the most disappointing part and I wish it hadn't been tied into the story at all.

[spoiler]It's the Backrooms again... I feel like it would've been better off building it's own identity rather than connecting it back to something that's been done to death in the indie horror space over and over again.[/spoiler]
